text.en:
The bond of twenty-five hundred pesos furnished by Jose Nazareno in favor of the Philippine
Government for the provisional release of Jose Castro y Obregon in criminal case No. 33547 of the Court of
First Instance of Manila, entitled "The People of the Philippine Islands versus Jose Castro y Obregon, et al.,"
which has been declared forfeited by said court, is hereby remitted after the expenses actually incurred by the
Government in the execution of the said bail bond have been deducted.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 8, 1934.
